Insperity pricing in 2026

Insperity is quote-only. The PEO admin fee runs $110-$180 PEPM (excluding pass-through benefits cost). The two service tiers are Workforce Optimization (full PEO) and Workforce Acceleration (ASO, you keep the EIN). Headline PEPM looks large because it bundles HR services, payroll, and master benefits administration.

What the buying committee actually pays

Headline PEPM looks large because it bundles HR services, payroll, and master benefits administration. The ledger applies a default 12% annual renewal uplift unless the buyer caps it in the MSA - our own central modelling assumption, adjustable on the renewal-uplift page, not a vendor-published rate.

What is the per-employee admin fee range?

$110-$180 PEPM admin fee. Pass-through benefits (health plan premium, workers comp, 401k administration) sit on top and are itemised separately.

Workforce Optimization vs Workforce Acceleration?

Workforce Optimization is the full PEO: Insperity becomes the co-employer, runs payroll, owns the benefits master contract. Workforce Acceleration (ASO) is service-only: you keep the EIN, Insperity provides HR services and payroll administration.

What are contract minimums?

50-seat practical floor. 1-year minimum contract; 2-3 year terms common.

How do master health plan costs compare?

Insperity's master medical typically lands 5-15% under directly-brokered plans for SMBs in tougher rating areas. Less arbitrage in low-cost markets.

When does Insperity beat TriNet or Justworks?

For 75-250 person companies that want a high-touch HR-services overlay (HR business partner, compliance support, training). Justworks wins on price; TriNet wins on technology UX; Insperity wins on full-service HR depth.
